For oily and acne-prone skin in India, look for gel-based or foaming cleansers containing active ingredients like **salicylic acid (BHA)**, **glycolic acid**, or **niacinamide**.[findingmadeeasy.com](https://findingmadeeasy.com/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-india/#:~:text=%F0%9F%A5%871.%20Minimalist%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Cleanser%20%28Best,Fragrance-free%20and%20gentle.%20*%20Helps%20reduce%20blackheads.) These ingredients help control excess sebum production, clear clogged pores, and prevent breakouts without stripping the skin of essential moisture.[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-face-wash-in-india#:~:text=This%20face%20wash%20is%20100%25%20gel-based%20and,skin%20types.%20What's%20the%20Reason%20to%20Pick%3F)

Here are top-rated options available well under ₹500:

The Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Cleanser combines **salicylic acid and zinc** to effectively reduce sebum, clear out deep-seated impurities, and control acne.

The Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash for Oily Acne Prone utilizes antioxidant-rich green tea and **glycolic acid** to gently exfoliate dead skin cells while keeping grease in check.

The The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne with 2% Salicylic Acid Niacinamide Face Wash pairs **salicylic acid with niacinamide** to fight breakouts, target blemishes, and soothe oily skin.

The Foxtale Oil & Acne Control Face Wash features **salicylic acid, niacinamide, and cica** to clear out pores, manage sebum, and calm skin inflammation.

The CeraVe Foaming Cleanser For Normal To Oily Skin relies on **ceramides and hyaluronic acid** to cleanse excess grease while maintaining the skin's natural protective barrier.

The Himalaya Neem Purifying Face Wash is a budget-friendly herbal option utilizing **neem and turmeric** to purify oily skin and fight acne-causing bacteria.

The the Deconstruct Salicylic Acid Oil Control Facewash uses a blend of **salicylic acid and niacinamide** to deep-clean pores and control sebum production effectively.
